provenance.method: Reviewed DVSA/GOV.UK bus and coach accessibility/help guidance on 2026-09-05; GB statutory scope kept separate from local concessions.

name: GOV.UK — buses and coaches: features and help for disabled people
description: Government guidance on accessibility features and assistance requirements for in-scope buses and coaches.
intended_use: Inspect Great Britain statutory accessibility/help expectations without confusing them with local concessionary eligibility.
audience_or_context: Great Britain — England, Scotland and Wales; in-scope bus and coach services under the cited regulations.
limitations: The rules do not cover every vehicle/service and contain exemptions.
This Resource does not determine an individual's concessionary-pass eligibility.
